dishes.make_ahead: Slit and stuff the dates up to 2 days ahead, airtight in the fridge; fry in the butter and honey on the night

steps.text: Toast the whole almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Slit and pit the Medjool dates, push an almond and a grind of black pepper into each and press closed.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the dates 2 minutes, turning, until warm and glossy.
Add the honey and let it bubble for 1 minute, turning the dates to coat.
Tip onto a plate and sprinkle with flaky salt.

dishes.n: Macrinus's baked feta with figs and honey
dishes.make_ahead: Assemble the dish up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge, without the honey; bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Put the block of feta in a small baking dish with the mixed olives around it.
Halve the fresh figs and nestle them in.
Drizzle with the olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano, chilli flakes and thyme sprigs.
Bake 15 minutes until the feta is soft.
Drizzle with the honey and serve with torn crusty bread.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the chicken with the oil, salt, garlic and thyme up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast on the night

steps.text: Rub the whole chicken with oil, salt, crushed garlic and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon.
Roast at 200C on a bed of the carrots for 60 minutes, then brush with the honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky.
Rest 10 minutes and carve.

veg.make_ahead: Boil and dry the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; rub and roast on the night

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, boil them whole for 6 minutes, then drain and leave to steam dry.
Rub the cauliflowers with the oil, salt, half the garlic crushed and the thyme. Sit them on a tray with the carrots, chickpeas, the rest of the garlic cloves and the halved lemon.
Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then brush the cauliflowers with the honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky.
Squeeze the roasted lemon into the yoghurt. Cut the cauliflowers into wedges and serve with the carrots, chickpeas and yoghurt.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead, then cool and keep covered in the fridge; drizzle with honey on the night

steps.text: Beat the ricotta with the eggs, the honey and the zest of the lemon until smooth.
Pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set.
Cool and drizzle with more honey.

dishes.make_ahead: Warm and strain up to 2 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; reheat gently and do not boil

steps.text: Pour the bottle of red wine into a saucepan with the honey, the cinnamon stick, the black peppercorns, the bay leaves and the strips of orange peel.
Warm gently over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring until the honey dissolves.
Do not let it boil.
Strain into heavy cups.
For non-drinkers, make it the same way with red grape juice and less honey.

af.make_ahead: Mix and warm up to 2 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; reheat gently and strain into cups

steps.text: Pour the grape juice and tea into a saucepan with the honey, the cinnamon stick, the black peppercorns, the bay leaves and strips of orange peel.
Warm gently over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring until the honey dissolves. Do not let it boil.
Strain into heavy cups.
